article.intro: Every map needs streets, and every street needs a name that sounds lived in. This **street name generator** makes British closes, crescents and wynds, American drives and boulevards, crooked fantasy alleys for your D&D city, rain-soaked cyberpunk skyways and some gloriously silly roads.
